Appearance

A huge wyvern with scarred, slate-green scales and a ragged left wing membrane patched with old scar tissue. Her barbed stinger drips amber venom. One eye is milky from an old arrow wound; the other burns yellow. A broken hunting spear juts from her shoulder, long healed over.

Part one: a flyover; she flees to BR3 at 100 HP or fewer. Part two: she returns 1d4 days later and fights to the death. Use the Diving actor for the swap mid-fight.
